priya_s: Quick heads-up — Altair agreed to join our preview next week. Goal: validate cost/perf guidance & capture enablement feedback. They want a 3-week window starting Tue 2026-04-06. Seats: 4 devs + 1 admin. Need: onboarding session, SSO + API key, and a short NPS-style feedback at week 1 and week 3.
ava_k: Awesome. I can run the onboarding + 1st-week office hours. Preferred slots? UTC-8 mornings work for them.
liam_t: FYI renewal risk flagged — procurement timelines are tight, they want ROI signals fast. We'll need usage targets and a short pilot metrics dashboard.
ev an_r: @liam_t can you draft the 3 KPIs we should surface? suggest: avg latency (p50/p95), tokens per session, and feature adoption (routes used). Keep it 1 pager.
liam_t: Yep — will do. Also recommend a small success plan: threshold of 10k tokens/week or we'll trigger a health touch.
priya_s: On SSO: Altair uses Okta. @marcus_support do we have the SAML checklist ready?
marcus_support: I have a minimal checklist — will DM the SAML metadata request and the IdP cert. Also will prepare a scoped API key template (least privilege) for the admin.
onboard-bot: calendar invite created: "Altair Preview Onboarding — 2026-04-06 16:00 UTC" (<https://calendar.redwood.com/event/altair-onboard>) :white_check_mark:
ava_k: Thanks bot :thumbsup: I'll add a short slide deck + sample prompts tailored to their commerce flows.
priya_s: Can someone own the feedback survey? Need to keep it <5 questions, mix of likert + open text. Ideally automated at day 7 and day 21.
ev an_r: I'll prototype a Google Forms flow and the webhook to collect responses into the CS dashboard. Will include one free-text prompt: "biggest friction with model outputs".
liam_t: Also request telemetry access: token-level cost breakdown and per-route latency. @marcus_support can you grant altair-preview read-only access to the analytics workspace?
marcus_support: Yep — will provision a read-only role scoped to their org id and send the invite.
ava_k: Quick ops note — we'll prepare two enablement cohorts: Core Devs (4) and Admins (1). Recommend separate follow-ups: 1-hr hands-on + 30min admin walkthrough.
priya_s: Great. I'll draft a one-page success plan and share by EOD. If everyone OK, I'll ping Altair with the agenda + SAML request.
liam_t: Thumbs up from me.
ev an_r: LGTM — I'll attach the survey and the minimal dashboard mock to your doc.
priya_s: Thanks all. I'll update this thread after the invite is accepted. :pray:
